'''Shesharile''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was located within the [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile system]], in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]].<ref name="GG6" />

A number of [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the large planet, only two of which were able to support life. Known as the Twin Planets, [[Shesharile 5]] and [[Shesharile 6]] were ruled by the same [[Star system/Legends|system]]-wide government. The societies of both worlds collapsed when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] terminated his business deals with the two moons to focus the use of its resources on building the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]].<ref name="GG6" />
